sources.role: Supermodel.ini parser, controller mapping, Model 3 ROM loading, NVRAM and save-state naming

paths.path: ~/.config/supermodel/Supermodel.ini (the packaged Config/Supermodel.ini is the fallback/default template)
paths.naming: INI sections use [ Global ] and optional [ <MAME ROM set> ]; settings are Name = value with quoted string values
Bindings are comma-separated tokens in keys such as InputStart1 = "KEY_1,JOY1_BUTTON9", InputJoyUp = "KEY_UP,JOY1_UP" and InputPunch = "KEY_A,JOY1_BUTTON1"; -config-inputs rewrites the file
evidence: docs:Supermodel README Learning and Configuring Game Controls

paths.path: No separate console BIOS file; Supermodel loads each Model 3 game's ROM set from the configured ROM directory
paths.naming: ROM sets use game-specific MAME names and component files (epr/mpr/crom/vrom/srom as declared by the game set); this source does not publish one canonical BIOS filename or checksum
evidence: source:Games/* ROM loader and ROM-set metadata

paths.path: No cryptographic firmware keys are used
Saves/NVRAM/ under the Supermodel installation/data root
paths.naming: NVRAM files are <game>.nv; they hold per-game settings/high scores and are written on exit
evidence: source:Config/Supermodel.ini NVRAM path and NVRAM writer
docs:Supermodel README Save States and NVRAM

paths.path: Saves/ under the Supermodel installation/data root
paths.naming: Save states are <game>.state<slot> for the selected slot (up to ten slots); F5/F7 save/load and F6 selects the slot
evidence: docs:Supermodel README Save States and NVRAM

paths.path: Config\Supermodel.ini beside the Windows executable (with the release ZIP's Config directory)
paths.naming: INI [ Global ]/per-game sections, Name = value entries
Comma-separated KEY_* and JOY* tokens, e.g. InputStart1 = "KEY_1,JOY1_BUTTON9"; -config-inputs writes mappings

paths.path: No separate BIOS; game-specific Model 3 ROM sets are loaded from the configured ROM path
paths.naming: epr/mpr/crom/vrom/srom component names are game-set-specific; no canonical BIOS checksum is published by this source
